_authority: SOLE configuration authority for PZ production deployment. Deploy-PZ.ps1 is the SOLE execution authority and reads every path, filename, and flag from this file. No deployment path, engine filename, or robocopy flag may be hardcoded anywhere else. Enforced by service/tests/test_deploy_authority.py.
_engine_files_authority: EVERY repository-root module that service/app imports. These live OUTSIDE service/app, so the application sync never carries them; Invoke-EngineSync copies exactly this list and nothing else. A root module missing here is deployed NEVER — it lingers at whatever version some past manual copy left, and the next release that adds a symbol to it ships an app tree whose imports fail at startup. Enforced by test_deploy_authority.py::test_engine_files_cover_every_root_module_the_app_imports.

gated_flags./MIR: PERMITTED ONLY after the destination-only inventory has classified every extraneous path, AND with protected_dirs/protected_files excluded. /MIR is REQUIRED for exact convergence and is the only mechanism that removes files a newer release introduced.

_health_auth_note: The health endpoints are authenticated (require_api_key / X-API-Key) BY DESIGN; an anonymous probe returns 401, which is correct app behaviour, not a deploy failure. The read-only validator authenticates as a legitimate caller by reading the SAME credential the service loads (health_auth_env_var from health_auth_env_file, the runtime .env) and presenting it as the X-API-Key header. Only the SOURCE lives here; the secret VALUE never enters this repo, the validator output, or any artifact. An explicit PZ_HEALTH_API_KEY environment variable (operator shell) overrides this source. The endpoint must NEVER be made anonymous to satisfy the validator.

Test counts are NOT stored here. The authority is test_baseline_contract; required counts are read from that file.

source_root is C:\PZ-main. C:\PZ-verify owns the repository .git and is the verification-read tree; it is NEVER a deploy source. C:\Users\Super Fashion\PZ APP was decommissioned 2026-07-17. C:\PZ-deploy-w12 (former reports/deploy/verify_sync.py source) no longer exists.
Deploy bytes come from artifact_root\app-<SHA> (immutable, hash-manifested), never from a live git tree. Rollback bytes come from backup_root, never from git.
/XO is FORBIDDEN: it skips files it judges not-newer, silently leaving stale destination files (2026-07-07 ImportError incident).
robocopy exit semantics: 0-3 success; >= robocopy_suspect_exit fatal unless the destination inventory classified it; >= robocopy_fatal_exit always fatal.

version_file is written by Deploy-PZ.ps1 ONLY, as BOM-free ASCII, and is read at runtime by service/app/api/routes_webhooks_wfirma_status.py using Python's utf-8 codec. A UTF-8 BOM would NOT be stripped by that reader and would corrupt the served SHA. Exactly one writer, pinned by test_deploy_authority.py.

Production writes require a signed, SHA-bound, single-use authorization artifact evaluated by authorization_helper. Presence of an environment variable is NOT authorization. The signing key lives outside this repository; with no key provisioned every deploy is denied, which is the intended default.
Lesson J: engine_files are NOT covered by the application sync; they need the separate source_root -> runtime_engine copy, verified by content hash, never by Python import.

Lesson J corollary (2026-08-02): the list held only 2 of the 16 root modules service/app imports. description_grammar.py had drifted since 2026-06-08 and no deployment could ever refresh it, so PR #1070 -- which added canonical_item_type / canonical_item_type_fuzzy / is_item_type_token to it -- would have shipped an app tree importing symbols the runtime copy lacked, failing at startup in routes_dhl_clearance, sales_packing_parser, invoice_packing_extractor and description_engine. CI cannot see this: the suite imports root modules from the repo root, where they are always current; only the deployed layout splits app from engine. The list is now derived from the imports themselves and pinned by a test.

Health-probe credential hygiene: the validator authenticates the health check with the service API_KEY (health_auth_env_var from health_auth_env_file) and NEVER writes it to output. Do NOT run Test-PZDeployClose.ps1 inside an active Start-Transcript session or with -Verbose: PowerShell would capture the X-API-Key header value verbatim regardless of the never-logged code path. The value is read into script scope either way; transcript/verbose capture is the only residual exposure and is an operator-shell hygiene rule, not a script defect.
